children.value: > Fact From Story: Nobody had a larger impact than Fred Warner, who finished the night with an interception, sack and forced fumble in a swarming performance.
> > Fact From Story: Fred Warner is a player on the 49ers defense.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: The performance of one player on defense can reflect the performance of the whole defense.
> Fact From Story: Defensively, the 49ers were relentless.
> > Fact From Story: The 49ers carved up Dallas' defense on the opening drive, and that was a sign of what was to come.
> > > Fact From Story: Dallas was sluggish through the first half of the game, and the night unraveled quickly when Dak Prescott threw three interceptions in the second half.
> > > Fact From Story: The Cowboys' offense looked very much like it did in last season's playoff exit -- uncomfortable and out of sorts.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A team whose offense is uncomfortable and throws interceptions is not playing well.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A defense that is able to shut down an opposing offense is a relentless defense.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A defense that records a sack, interception, and forced fumble in one game is playing relentlessly.
